description: Forward-looking data backlog for UniAtlas Bosnia: data still to be checked or collected, deferred work with concrete leads, and reference material for future issues (kept here only when it exists in no other data file or in the DB). Replaces the historical edgeCases.json - the full resolved-case log of issue #359 lives in git history of that file.

categories.missing-ects: programs seeded with null ECTS/duration whose values are obtainable with more digging
categories.held-out-data: collected program/faculty data deliberately NOT seeded - preserved here as the only copy
categories.unnamed-programs: cycles/levels that exist but publish no program names yet - re-check periodically
categories.dual-variant: programs officially offered in two ECTS/duration models - null by convention; candidates for per-variant Track rows
categories.name-watch: names that drift between sources - re-check on next collection pass
categories.future-modeling: schema/feature leads with the data needed to start
categories.missing-programs: programs/levels known to exist that we intentionally or provisionally do not carry

items.title: ~151 programs without ECTS
items.details: No central ECTS source; untz.ba studijski-programi pages list programs only.
items.lead: Per-program NPP pages/PDFs on untz.ba; site blocks plain fetches - curl with a browser User-Agent works. III ciklus likely 180 (statute).

items.title: ~71 II/III programs without ECTS
items.details: Konkurs 2026/27 lists quotas only; III-cycle conditions PDF has entry rules only.
items.lead: RS-law structure: II = 60-after-240 or 120-after-180; III = 180/3y. UES PRVI ECTS are already in the data, so UNIBL-style 300-cumulative arithmetic is plausible - verify per faculty before applying (UNIBL's own guide confirmed it for UNIBL only).

items.title: strukturne promjene u natječaju/Vodiču
items.details: 'Fizika' now exists only as 'Fizika - dvopredmetni studij'; natječaj enrolls grouped programs with smjerovi (ALU 'Likovne umjetnosti', APTF 'Agronomija'/'Prehrambena tehnologija') while our rows are per-smjer; dvopredmetni variants exist for many FPMOZ/FF programs and are intentionally not tracked as separate rows.

items.title: ETF 'Razvoj softvera' stručni - discontinued?

items.title: registry oddities
items.details: rsp.unsa.ba lists DSAI with a link to /strucni-studij (copy-paste error); EF joint master's English dataset name is empty; registry cycles now include 'Neciklični' and 'Integrirani/Integrisani' spelling variants.
items.lead: rsp.unsa.ba is a clean JSON API - use it for future UNSA passes.

items.title: konkurs vs site naming
items.details: Konkurs uses degree-style names ('PROFESOR INFORMATIKE I TEHNIKE') where the site uses program names ('Informatika i tehničko obrazovanje') - site names were seeded.

items.title: co-faculty ownership of joint programs (M2M)
items.details: Six joint programs carry a single lead faculty in the DB; co-owners: UNSA 'Interdisciplinarni studij konzervacija i restauracija' (ALU + PMF, + Arhitektonski for DRUGI); UNSA 'Informatika u upravi' (Fakultet za upravu + Ekonomski); UNIBL 'Očuvanje i održiva upotreba genetičkih resursa' (Poljoprivredni + PMF); UNIBL 'Obnovljivi izvori energije i ekološko inženjerstvo' (AGGF + ETF + Mašinski + Tehnološki); UNTZ 'Primjenjena hemija' (Tehnološki + PMF); UNZE 'Doktorski studij iz tehničkih nauka' (FIPN + Mašinski + Politehnički).
items.lead: Additive join-table design (StudyProgramCoFaculty, facultyId stays lead) is written in the issue #359 plan.

items.title: odsjek layer (department between faculty and program)
items.details: Known odsjek data: UNSA ETF/ALU odsjeci in sources; UNBI Tehnički fakultet odsjeci seeded as program names (Mašinski/Građevinski/Elektrotehnički/Tekstilni odsjek); IUT smjer 'Logistički menadžment' exists under two odsjeka (Logistika; Inžinjerski menadžment) - merged into one row per cycle.
items.lead: Lite design: odsjek String @default('') on StudyProgram + unique(name,facultyId,cycle,odsjek); full design in the issue #359 plan.

items.title: smjer/track backlog beyond the 29 seeded
items.details: UES usmjerenja were stripped during collection ('Mašinstvo - Proizvodno mašinstvo' style) - re-mine from source; SUM natječaj lists smjerovi per program (Geografija: opći/Turizam i zaštita okoliša; Glazbena pedagogija: 3 smjera; Glazbena umjetnost: Klavir/Violina; ALU/APTF groupings); UNIBL Šumarstvo-120 smjerovi named in Vodič; Kallos smjer-style names ('Opći smjer', 'Konstrukcije').
items.lead: Track model + seed support exist.

items.title: 'specijalistički studij' level missing from cycle enum
items.details: SUM offers poslijediplomski specijalistički studiji (natječaj 2026/27 title mentions them; Pravo osiguranja + 2 FF studies); some private universities use the level too.
items.lead: Same pattern as the STRUCNI addition (enum + migration + zod + webapp labels).

items.title: subject seeding - verified easy starting points
items.details: FIT Mostar (fit.sum.ba) and ETF Banja Luka publish full per-program curricula suitable for subject seeding.
items.lead: Subjects model and API already exist; JSON shape would mirror studyPrograms.json one level deeper.

items.title: ~16 site-only programs not seeded
items.details: NPP PDFs/menu entries exist for ~16 programs absent from the 2026/27 konkurs (possibly paused); not seeded per konkurs-authority convention.
items.lead: If they reappear in a konkurs, seed from the already-located NPP PDFs.

items.title: Vodič I-cycle cross-check
items.details: UNIBL Vodič 2026/27 I-cycle lists may contain programs missing from our data (e.g. AGGF 'Dizajn enterijera' 240, PMF 'Geografski informacioni sistemi'). Not verified this pass.
items.lead: Cross-check guide I-cycle listings vs our UNIBL rows.

items.title: dvopredmetni studiji not tracked
items.details: FPMOZ/FF dvopredmetni variants (Biologija, Fizika, Geografija, Informatika, Kemija, Matematika, Pedagogija, Informacijske znanosti, Povijest umjetnosti) exist as separate programs (3y/180, DRUGI 2y/120) - intentionally not separate rows.

items.title: 27 PRVI programs without ECTS/duration
items.details: Konkurs 2026/27 I-ciklus table is quotas-only; faculty pages are sparse. The II-cycle fills (60/1y) derive from the konkurs entry rule (II ciklus requires 240 ECTS, Statut cl. 142/143) and the explicit 4+1 naming.
items.lead: The same statute rule implies academic PRVI programs are 240/4y (UNBI is a 4+1 university) - verify per faculty/NPP before applying; 'Stručni studij poslovne ekonomije' is likely 180/3y (stručni).

items.title: 3 programs in initial accreditation - no data published
items.details: Agroekologija (PRVI i DRUGI) and 'Održiva poljoprivreda i ruralni razvoj' (TRECI) pages state 'Studije su u fazi početne akreditacije' - brand-new programs without NPP/ECTS.
items.lead: Re-check pf.ubn.rs.ba after accreditation completes.

items.title: MF Metrologija (DRUGI) runs in two models — ects kept null
items.details: Mašinski fakultet offers Metrologija II ciklus in BOTH 4+1 (60 ECTS, 1y) and 3+2+3 (120 ECTS, 2y); the 2026/27 II-cycle konkurs lists 'Metrologija' and 'Metrologija (3+2+3)' as separate rows. Merged row stays null per the group-D decision; candidates for Track variants if dual-model rows ever get modeled.
items.lead: Elaborats: mf.unze.ba/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/Elaborat-II-ciklusa-Metrologija-4-1-3-kompletno.pdf and .../Elaborat-II-ciklusa-Metrologija-323-kompletno.pdf

items.title: FIPN II-cycle masters absent from studyPrograms.json
items.details: FIPN runs three II-cycle programs (Metalurgija; Materijali/Inženjerstvo materijala with metalni+nemetalni smjerovi; Hemijsko inženjerstvo), each 60 ECTS / 1y ('zajedno s prvim ciklusom 300 ECTS'), enrolling in the 2026/27 konkurs (14 seats). JSON has no DRUGI rows for this faculty.
items.lead: https://www.fipn.unze.ba/ii-ciklus-studija/ has full description incl. ECTS.

items.title: Pravni fakultet II-cycle master absent from studyPrograms.json
items.details: 2026/27 II-cycle konkurs lists Pravni fakultet 'Opći smjer' master (uže oblasti: Građansko, Krivično, Historija države i prava, Državno i međunarodno javno pravo) with 32 seats; JSON has only PRVI Pravo.
items.lead: prf.unze.ba for NPP/ECTS; likely 60/1y under 4+1.

items.title: Doctoral programs at Pravni and Ekonomski fakultet absent from studyPrograms.json
items.details: unze.ba published 2025/26 III-cycle konkursi for Pravni fakultet (doktorski studij) and Ekonomski fakultet (Poslovna ekonomija). Neither faculty has a TRECI row in JSON.
items.lead: Konkursi on unze.ba state duration/ECTS (UNZE doctoral standard: 3y/180): konkurs-natjecaj-za-upis...na-pravnom-fakultetu...2025-2026... and ...poslovna-ekonomija-na-ekonomskom-fakultetu...2025-2026...

items.title: MEDF 'Zdravstvena njega i menadžment' (DRUGI) absent from studyPrograms.json
items.details: 2026/27 II-cycle konkurs lists Medicinski fakultet master 'Zdravstvena njega i menadžment' with 20 seats; JSON has no DRUGI row for MEDF. medf.unze.ba has a master-studij page.
items.lead: https://medf.unze.ba/master-studij/

items.title: MF 'Obnovljivi izvori energije i okolinski aspekti' (DRUGI) listed with zero seats
items.details: Appears in the 2026/27 II-cycle konkurs plan for Mašinski fakultet with / / / / seats (no enrollment); not in JSON. Watch whether it activates.
items.lead: mf.unze.ba studijski-programi nav for a future NPP.

items.title: MF 'Mašinstvo' vs konkurs/site name 'Mašinstvo i robotika'
items.details: JSON row Mašinski fakultet [PRVI] 'Mašinstvo' (180/3) corresponds to the program the faculty and the 2026/27 konkurs call 'Mašinstvo i robotika (trogodišnji studij)' (odsjek under the 3+2+3 stručni model).
items.lead: https://mf.unze.ba/i-ciklus-studija-323/

items.title: MF calls its 3+2+3 first-cycle programs 'dodiplomski stručni studij'
items.details: MF page describes 'Mašinstvo i robotika' and 'Dizajn i tehnologije u drvopreradi' as dodiplomski STRUČNI studij (3y/180) under Bologna 3+2+3, yet the university konkurs files them under regular I ciklus. Kept as PRVI per the locked group-A decision (source label wins was applied to UNSA registry labels; UNZE registry/konkurs files these as I ciklus). Revisit only if STRUCNI scope is ever widened.
items.lead: https://mf.unze.ba/i-ciklus-studija-323/
